name: za-foreign-employment-exemption
description: South African section 10(1)(o)(ii) foreign employment income exemption for tax residents rendering services outside the Republic. Covers the day tests that gate the exemption, the work-day apportionment formula SARS actually applies, the annual cap, how to choose the twelve month window, how to count full days across border stamps and overnight flights, how the IRP5 must be coded, and the ITR12 containers. Use for any question about working abroad, seconded employees, expatriates, contractors on foreign assignment, touring professionals, the 183 and 60 day tests, code 4041, or the R1.25 million foreign employment cap.
